# Finance & Ops Skills Index

Find the agent skills that software vendors publish for their own finance and business-operations products — accounting, payments, e-commerce, CRM — and see how far each can be trusted before you install it.

## What it does

The plugin adds one skill, `finance-ops-skills`. Claude uses it when you ask whether skills exist for a platform, which one fits a task, or whether one is safe to use. It answers from a catalog bundled in the plugin: for each skill, the upstream link, who published it (the vendor itself, or a third party), its licence, and an independent grade — can it write to your books, can it move money, does it send your prompts to the vendor. Vendors with nothing published are listed as such rather than left out.

Catalog as of **2026-10-01** · 67 skills · 28 vendors.

## How to use it

Install it, then ask in plain language:

- "Are there any official skills for Xero?"
- "Which QuickBooks skills can post journal entries?"
- "Is there a Stripe skill that moves money, and does it ask first?"
- "What should I use to reconcile Shopify payouts?"

In Claude Code:

```
/plugin marketplace add MosoFin/finance-ops-skills-index
/plugin install finance-ops-skills-index@finance-ops-skills-index
```

On claude.ai and in Cowork, add it from **Customize > Plugins**.

The plugin never installs a vendor skill for you. Follow the upstream link it gives you and install from the vendor.

## Data

The plugin sends nothing anywhere. It has no MCP server, no hooks and no scripts, makes no network calls and holds no credentials; it reads only its own bundled Markdown files. The vendor skills it points to are separate software with their own data practices, which the catalog notes where they send telemetry.

## Coverage

amazon-sp, bigcommerce, clio, clover, ebay, ecwid, ehr, etsy, gmail, google-ads, harvest, housecallpro, hubspot, jobber, klaviyo, lightspeed-x, meta-ads, ncr-voyix, paypal, quickbooks, servicem8, servicetitan, shopify, square, stripe, toast, woocommerce, xero.
